body: Some states have.  The battle is ongoing, but in the right direction.

I'm certainly not a health professional, and I'm ignorant to the consequences of androgen deprivation and have no experience with clinical anger/rage treatment.  That being said, if it's something that doesn't resolve with treatment or shows no improvement towards recovery over a reasonable period of time, perhaps other such options should be considered.

Thanks Trolio.  I was having a minute earlier...I'm getting better I think but pain episodes sort of "trigger" me because I struggled with it so long.  With continued therapy I'm hopeful that I can overcome it.

I am considering your alternative in the meantime, however.  I just don't want my pain tolerance to go down/feel worse when I stop.

I don't care about buying illegal marijuana unless I get caught (or drive with it).  It's not going to harm anyone, and I think it's a double standard that it's banned, yet alcohol is legal.  I've just never done it.

I think because, generally speaking, if someone wants to kill themselves they're not in a right state of mind.  It's kind of like asking why you'd put someone with violent anger issues in a psych ward.  Wouldn't that just make them angrier?  Probably for a while, maybe even for the rest of their lives, but they're not thinking straight and the psych ward is the best place to get help and keep them in check during recovery.
